task_completion.description: The abdominal CT scan (amos_0001) is loaded into the medical imaging software (e.g., 3Slicer).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CT volume is visible in the 2D slice viewers and the volume name is listed in the Data module/Data probe.

task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the L4-L5 vertebral level for measurement.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The slice viewer shows the lumbar spine at the L4-L5 intervertebral disc level; the slice index or coordinate is adjusted.

task_completion.description: The agent applies a threshold to isolate adipose tissue using the standard HU range (-190 to -30).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Segment Editor or Threshold tool is open with the range set approximately to -190 and -30, showing a highlighted mask over fat areas.

task_completion.description: The agent separates the segmentation into Subcutaneous (SAT) and Visceral (VAT) adipose tissue compartments.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Two distinct segment colors are visible: one for the outer fat layer (SAT) and one for the internal fat around organs (VAT).

task_completion.description: The segmentation is saved to the specified file path: ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/fat_segmentation.nii.gz.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' dialog or a terminal confirmation shows the file being written to the exact path and filename specified.

task_completion.description: A JSON report is generated containing the required fields: measurement_level, slice_index, sat_area_cm2, vat_area_cm2, vat_sat_ratio, and fat_distribution.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output displays the content of 'fat_analysis_report.json' with all six required keys present.

integrity.description: The agent used the medical imaging GUI (e.g., Slicer) to perform segmentation rather than just writing a script to generate dummy files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Segment Editor, Threshold sliders, or manual painting tools.

integrity.description: The areas and ratios in the report are derived from the actual segmentation, not hardcoded placeholders.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Segment Statistics' or 'Quantification' module is visible in the GUI showing calculated area/volume values that match the JSON report.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy a pre-existing JSON file from another directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen actively typing the report values or using a 'Save' function within the quantification tool.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The standard Hounsfield Unit (HU) range for adipose tissue quantification is -190 to -30. The L4-L5 level is the clinical standard for this measurement. The report must contain exactly these fields: measurement_level, slice_index, sat_area_cm2, vat_area_cm2, vat_sat_ratio, and fat_distribution.
